cleanupBoundary.rollback: Keep the previously active page revision and frozen W00 catalog source available; never restore its database backup over newer gameplay without an explicit reconciliation decision.

versioning.rule: Reuse an existing contract only when meaning and closed response shape are unchanged. Otherwise add a new immutable version and keep the prior version readable through the compatibility window.
compatibilityOrder: add and validate the new catalog object/query/mechanic version
teach the server and browser adapter to read both old and new versions
migrate or backfill live records in a tested transaction when state shape changes
activate the new mapping or query version
remove the old reader only after live verification and the declared compatibility window

migrationRules.queryOnlyProjection: No database migration; register and validate the new projection before activating the client.
migrationRules.componentShapeChange: Requires an export, tested migration/backfill, validation, activation, and recovery point.
migrationRules.relationshipMeaningChange: Requires a new qualified relationship kind or versioned object contract; never reinterpret existing edges in place.
migrationRules.uiAssemblyOnly: No catalog or database migration; preserve the accepted response contract.

small.expectation: Every authorized view is ready or explicitly empty and completes in one page.

large.expectation: Every collection follows stable continuation tokens to the declared maximum without omissions, duplicates, source-revision drift, or unrelated-population scaling.

unauthorized.expectation: Forbidden or intentionally unavailable results remain distinct from empty results, and no canary identity or value reaches response data, browser cache, diagnostics, or rendered text.

gateSemantics.status: These are acceptance ceilings, not measured improvement claims. A target gate becomes mandatory when its target owner replaces the legacy path; currentCost records the existing bound until then.
gateSemantics.featureRequests: Maximum data requests for one user-triggered feature load. Each explicit continuation repeats the same per-page gate up to target.maximumPages.
gateSemantics.featureSql: Maximum production-path SQL statements for one feature load; catalog/source-only work may report zero but must still provide measured evidence.
gateSemantics.featureBytes: responseBytes is the aggregate transport body allowance for one feature load; retainedResponseBytes is the maximum validated response data retained for that audience scope.
gateSemantics.completeWorkload: The served read-only journey traverses every delivered feature, all continuations, direct entry, reload, Back/Forward, retry, lazy assets, Rules and Installed Content. Tactical-board writes remain a separate disposable acceptance flow.
